idea-plugin.name: YoYo Terminal Launcher
idea-plugin.description:
YoYo Terminal Launcher

A fast, seamless IntelliJ IDEA extension that adds a header toolbar button and a dedicated keyboard shortcut to open the integrated terminal and run the yoyo CLI command (YoYo Platform) directly in your active project workspace.

✨ Key Features

  • Dynamic Plugin: Instant activation upon installation without requiring an IDE restart.
  • Header Toolbar Action: Accessible directly from the top-right header toolbar (MainToolbarRight in Modern UI).
  • Keyboard Shortcut: Quick trigger using Cmd+Option+Y (macOS) or Ctrl+Alt+Y (Windows/Linux).
  • Integrated Terminal: Opens a dedicated terminal tab titled YoYo Platform pointing to the current project root path.
  • Theme Aware: Features custom YoYo branding with automatic light and dark IDE theme switching.

🌐 Source Code & Repository

Developed by João Alves (j-nart).
GitHub Repository: https://github.com/joaonart/intellij-yoyo-plugin

⌨️ Default Keyboard Shortcut

  • macOS: Cmd + Option + Y
  • Windows / Linux: Ctrl + Alt + Y

⚠️ Community Plugin Disclaimer: This is an independent, community-developed plugin created by João Alves (j-nart) and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or officially associated with YoYo Platform.
